clips.title: Jump
clips.passCriterion: Grow takeoff and landing held-rig extrema further on the existing beats—deeper and wider arcs, not only a taller spike—so jump weight reads clearly on the fixed camera. Keep the quiet extendable air hold and the takeoff/air/land Action split.

clips.title: Forward ADS v4
clips.passCriterion: It needs its own ADS walk, sights locked on center, almost no side yaw, and a tighter vertical bounce.

clips.title: Backward ADS v4
clips.passCriterion: It needs its own ADS walk backward, sights locked on center, and a path that reads as backward instead of a wide figure-8.

clips.title: Left ADS v4
clips.passCriterion: It needs its own ADS strafe left, sights locked on center, and no rightward overshoot.

clips.title: Right ADS v4
clips.passCriterion: It needs its own ADS strafe, sights locked on center, a rightward path with no left overshoot, and a fast shallow bounce.

clips.title: Forward ADS v5 trial 1
clips.passCriterion: Keep the sight lock. Restore a dedicated ADS forward walk with the reference's shallow footfall and cadence. The bottom is nearly still.

clips.title: Forward ADS v6 trial 1
clips.passCriterion: Keep the sight lock. Restore a dedicated ADS forward walk with the reference’s shallow, sharp footfall and cadence. The bottom is still nearly still.

clips.title: Forward ADS v7
clips.passCriterion: Keep the sight lock. Grow the existing footfall dips to reference depth and sharpness on the same beats; micro-articulation alone is not enough.

clips.title: Forward ADS v8
clips.passCriterion: Keep the sight lock. Grow the existing footfall dips to reference depth and sharpness on the same beats; swapping HIP r5 under the same ADS hold did not grow path size.

clips.title: Left ADS lateral trial 1
clips.passCriterion: Drive left strafe from dedicated ADS locomotion, not HIP r1 under an ADS pose. Lock sights on center. Replace the wide figure-8 with a tight left-strafe drag and reference-scale bounce at about 0.50s and 0.95s.

clips.title: Right ADS lateral trial 1
clips.passCriterion: Drive right strafe from dedicated ADS locomotion, not HIP r1 under an ADS pose. Lock sights on center. Replace the pendulum figure-8 with a braced right path and sharp shallow dips at about 0.33s and 1.00s.

clips.title: Left ADS lateral trial 2
clips.passCriterion: Keep optical sight lock. Grow the left-strafe half-cycle path and step dips to reference depth and sharpness on the existing beats; current mass travel is still far below the reference and still crosses both ways.

clips.title: Right ADS lateral trial 2
clips.passCriterion: Keep the rightward bias and optical sight lock. Grow the right-strafe half-cycle path and step dips to reference depth and sharpness on the existing beats; amplitude is still far below the reference.

clips.title: Left ADS lateral trial 3
clips.passCriterion: Keep the sight lock. Grow the left-strafe path and step dips to reference depth and sharpness on the existing beats; Trial3 shape on r5 stayed near-flat versus the same-r5 Trial2 control and far below the reference.

clips.title: Right ADS lateral trial 3
clips.passCriterion: Keep the sight lock. Grow the right-strafe path and step dips to reference depth and sharpness on the existing beats; Trial3 shape on r5 stayed near-flat versus the same-r5 Trial2 control and far below the reference.
